FOUND 3
- `src/render.js:20`: nothing tested the new `isLantern` guard or the `drawFrost` branch in `draw`, so either could be removed without a test failing. I added a test to `test/brazier.test.js` that checks a frost tower gets its diamond and no lantern pool. Without the guard it fails 1 of 13; with it, it passes. **Fixed** (bbc6357).
- `src/main.js:80`: `main.js` does not pass the selected kind to `draw`, so the HUD does not show it. The brief and triage both ask for this. **Left** because `test/pause-speed.test.js` pins the HUD text exactly and is outside the signed touches. This was already explained in 5e7f6dd, and it is not in the acceptance criterion. A follow-up whose scope includes that test needs to wire it.
- `src/render.js:375` (`drawKind`), `src/render.js:248` (the slowed-ghost colour) and `src/render.js:305` (the frost shot colour): no test checks any of these. **Left** because `test/render.test.js` is outside touches, and `test/frost.test.js` is the locked reproducer, so it can't be edited.

GATES green: `npm --prefix . run test` passed 122/122 and `node --test test/brazier.test.js test/frost.test.js` passed 19/19. This clone has no Makefile, so `make check-build` was not available and these node tests were the check. The tree is committed and clean.
